content_sections.heading: About HBCH & RC Punjab
content_sections.text: Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital and Research Centre, Punjab is a unit of Tata Memorial Centre, a Grant-in-Aid institute under the Department of Atomic Energy, Government of India. The notice is issued by its HRD Department and signed by the Director, HBCH & RC, Punjab. The centre is at Medicity, New Chandigarh, SAS Nagar, Punjab.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The post of Scientific Officer (Healthcare Data Scientist) on ad-hoc basis has 1 vacancy. The qualification can be met in any one of three ways, shown below with the experience the notice prints for each. The notice adds that one year of experience is required for a Masters Degree in Data Science and related disciplines. Track record of generating Management Information System (MIS) / Performance Monitoring and Evaluation System (PMES) / AI & Deep Learning architectures for Healthcare / SQL/DBMS / DL frameworks in Python. Proficiency in Data Analytics, Python/R, Power BI / Tableau dashboards. Excellent written communication and presentation skills. The age limit is up to 40 years. Age and experience are reckoned as on the date of the walk-in interview, and experience is reckoned after the required qualifications. If the post is only for the unreserved category, age relaxation is not applicable to reserved candidates. The gross pay is Rs. 90,000/- to Rs. 1,00,000/- per month. The salary shall be determined based on the relevant work experience acquired after completion of the essential qualification. The ad-hoc post is for a tenure of one year from the date of appointment or till the finalization of the permanent post, whichever is earlier. TMC also may exercise the option to offer appointment on "Contract Basis" for a fixed term, initially for one year, on a consolidated remuneration. Appointed candidates may be rotated to any unit of TMC as and when the units concerned need it. The notice names Tata Memorial Hospital, Mumbai; ACTREC, Navi Mumbai; Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital, Sangrur; Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre, Mullanpur; Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre, Visakhapatnam; Mahamana Pt. Madan Mohan Malviya Cancer Centre (BHU), Varanasi; Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital, Varanasi; and BBCI, Guwahati.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Photocopies of the following documents are to be submitted at the time of interview. Candidates should also carry the original documents for verification. Updated resume and 2 recent passport size photographs (mandatory). Date of birth proof: Birth Certificate / School leaving Certificate / SSC passing certificate. Educational qualification: mark sheet and passing certificate for all examinations. Experience certificate: for past employment, a certificate showing the dates of joining and relieving; for current employment, the appointment letter and last pay slip. Copy of PAN Card and Aadhar Card. Caste certificate: valid Caste Certificate (in the Government of India format); Caste Validity Certificate in case of ST; Non-Creamy Layer Certificate in case of OBC candidates is mandatory. Economically Weaker Section (EWS) certificate in valid format. Persons with Disability: Physical Disability Certificate. PwBD: Autism, Intellectual Disability, Specific Learning Disability & Mental illness with disability i.e. Specific Learning Disability (SLD), as printed in the notice.

faq.question: Q1. When is the HBCH & RC Punjab walk-in interview for Scientific Officer?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 26.11.2026, with reporting from 09:30 A.M. to 11:30 A.M.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the walk-in interview held?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates attend at HRD Department, 6th floor, Wing-C, Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre, Plot No. 1, Medicity, New Chandigarh, SAS Nagar, Punjab-140901.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Scientific Officer (Healthcare Data Scientist) on ad-hoc basis, at HBCH & RC, Punjab.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Scientific Officer (Healthcare Data Scientist)?
faq.answer: A PhD in Data Science and AI / Applied Statistics / Biostatistics / Computer Science or equivalent; or a B.Tech / BS (4 years) in the listed fields with at least 2 years experience; or a recognised Post-Graduate degree in Science, Engineering, Technology, Health Administration / Public Health / Management with at least 3 years experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is up to 40 years, reckoned as on the date of the walk-in interview, with relaxation for SC/ST, OBC, PWD, ex-servicemen and TMC employees as listed above.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary?
faq.answer: The gross salary is Rs. 90,000/- to Rs. 1,00,000/- per month, determined on the relevant work experience acquired after completing the essential qualification.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry?
faq.answer: Carry photocopies of the resume, 2 passport size photographs, date of birth proof, mark sheets and certificates, experience documents, PAN and Aadhar cards, and category or disability certificates as applicable, plus the originals for verification.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the ad-hoc post is for one year from the date of appointment or till the finalization of the permanent post, whichever is earlier. TMC may also offer appointment on contract basis, initially for one year, on a consolidated remuneration.

faq.question: Q9. Can government or PSU employees attend the interview?
faq.answer: Yes, but they must obtain permission from the Head of their Organization and produce it at the interview. Without it they shall not be allowed to appear.

faq.question: Q10. Who can apply for this post?
faq.answer: The advertisement is open to Indian Nationals only.
